practice_observation: Read-only Opus review caught real defects the worker's tests had not (the list-cycles crash, the intensity pop, union versus intersection, unbounded memory). The first merge passed every gate and 253 acceptance tests, yet the wave-1 picture review found rain inside the room, sizzling streaks, inverted parallax, disc rings and marble beads, which the criteria cannot see; the look needed three rounds before merge and a rework after it, because the plan's sketch values read badly at review size. Costs: editing src while a review or acceptance run was going invalidated runs several times (6 to 25 min each; freeze the commit first); a full shared filesystem corrupted one rework round and cost a rebuild; a hand-cut room mask was thrown away when EC-0's shared mask landed. The card routed Luna and a Sonnet session delivered, so this does not test Luna.
